full_judgment: 30. These kind of transfers have been taking place in this country for a long time and have been mentioned in at least one statue i.e. in section 96(10) of the State Acquisition and Tenancy Act, 1950. According to that provision certain gift or Heba are exempted from pre-emption, but not a "Heba-bil- Ewaz for pecuniary consideration".
